"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Economic elites defer timelines of action to 2050 or later, beyond the time they have to deal with consequences of their failures.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Faster decarbonization will give all people the greatest chance of avoiding more catastrophic climate tipping points.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA is fighting for a social order that works for people and the planet, not profit.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA is fighting for a Green New Deal that ends the domination of massive corporations over people's lives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA is fighting for a Green New Deal that repairs infrastructure.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA is fighting for a Green New Deal that regenerates living systems.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
